_comment: Leads row settings (owner request 2026-10-17). campaignTags: contact tags that identify a campaign, matched exactly (case-insensitive) against the contact's current tags; a lead with several campaign tags counts in each tag's column but once in totals. 'ccusa' and 'ccn26' were removed on 2026-10-17 (owner edit); 'ccusa26' is the tag present on contacts. outcomeStages: pipeline stage names (any pipeline, case-insensitive) shown as rows on New Lead Outcomes; a lead counts when its current opportunity sits in the stage (snapshot) or when the stage history recorded it there since tracking began (event). deadEndStages: pipeline stage names (any pipeline, case-insensitive) that mean the lead is parked, so a lead sitting in one is not 'in a working stage'. newLeadStageName: the stage name that means untouched. touchWindowDays: 'Touched' = any outbound call, SMS, or email to the contact within this many days before now. staleAfterDays: a lead still in New Lead for more than this many days is stale. topSources: how many sources the source donut shows before folding the rest into Other.
